items.name: 01_grey_ramp
items.expected_observation: Grey ramp remains neutral and smooth.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Large-area ramp shows tinting or visible contouring.
items.pass_hint: Look for a smooth grey-only ramp at warm and cool extremes.

items.name: 09_grey_steps
items.expected_observation: Discrete grey steps remain neutral without abrupt jumps.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Adjacent steps pick up tint or show uneven spacing.
items.pass_hint: Each grey step should stay neutral and visually ordered.

items.name: 10_luma_node_chart
items.expected_observation: Node-aligned greys should not show visible bin transitions.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Exact node positions show visible output jumps.
items.pass_hint: Check for abrupt transitions at node-aligned patches.

items.name: 11_ui_text_contrast
items.expected_observation: Light-theme UI blocks stay neutral and text edges remain clean.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Cards or fine bars develop tint or color fringing.
items.pass_hint: White and light-grey UI surfaces should stay neutral.

items.name: near_black_steps
items.expected_observation: Near-black steps stay separable and neutral.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Shadow steps merge together or show colored patches.
items.pass_hint: Dark steps should remain distinct and neutral at both extremes.

items.name: near_white_steps
items.expected_observation: Near-white steps stay neutral before clipping.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Upper steps compress suddenly or drift pink/blue/yellow.
items.pass_hint: Near-white patches should stay separated until clipping.

items.name: ui_dark_theme_chart
items.expected_observation: Dark-theme UI layers remain stable without color cast.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Dark panels separate poorly or pick up colored haze.
items.pass_hint: Dark layered panels should remain neutral and legible.

items.name: rgb_cmy_color_bars
items.expected_observation: Primary and secondary bars should preserve their hue families.
items.expected_artifact_if_fail: Bars skew toward adjacent families or clip unevenly.
items.pass_hint: Each bar should stay within its hue family after adjustment.
